create_flaubert_tokenizer: create a FlaubertTokenizer instance from vocab and merges files with language support
build_bpe_tokens: build BPE tokenized output from a string using the FlaubertTokenizer bpe method
run_moses_pipeline: run the Moses preprocessing pipeline to normalize and tokenize text for a given language
build_inputs_special_tokens: build model inputs with special tokens for single or pair sequence classification
save_tokenizer_vocab: save the FlaubertTokenizer vocabulary and merges files to a directory
